description: Historical Yes/No display-price time series for one Polymarket US market by slug. `interval` picks a fixed lookback window (1h | 6h | 1d | 1w | 1m | all); `fidelity` is the spacing between points in minutes (default 60). Returns an array of {timestamp, yes_price, no_price} — these are DISPLAY prices (yes normally derived from the best ask, no from one minus the best bid) and preserve the bid/ask spread, so yes_price + no_price can exceed 1.0 — that is not a data error. Get a slug from polymarket_us_search.

slug.description: Polymarket US market slug, from polymarket_us_search.
